description:
The Chinook music store database is open in LibreOffice Base. The accounting department needs a single flat table containing all invoice line item details for their legacy reporting tool, which cannot perform table joins.

Create a new table named "InvoiceReport" by executing SQL statements (via Tools > SQL or the query SQL view). The table must have these exact 14 columns:

1. "InvoiceLineId" INTEGER - from InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId
2. "InvoiceId" INTEGER - from Invoice.InvoiceId
3. "InvoiceDate" TIMESTAMP - from Invoice.InvoiceDate
4. "CustomerName" VARCHAR(80) - Customer.FirstName || ' ' || Customer.LastName
5. "CustomerCountry" VARCHAR(40) - from Customer.Country
6. "SupportRepName" VARCHAR(80) - Employee.FirstName || ' ' || Employee.LastName
7. "TrackName" VARCHAR(200) - from Track.Name
8. "AlbumTitle" VARCHAR(160) - from Album.Title
9. "ArtistName" VARCHAR(120) - from Artist.Name
10. "GenreName" VARCHAR(120) - from Genre.Name
11. "MediaTypeName" VARCHAR(120) - from MediaType.Name
12. "UnitPrice" NUMERIC(10,2) - from InvoiceLine.UnitPrice
13. "Quantity" INTEGER - from InvoiceLine.Quantity
14. "LineTotal" NUMERIC(10,2) - calculated as UnitPrice * Quantity

Populate the table by joining these 8 tables:
- InvoiceLine -> Invoice (on InvoiceId)
- Invoice -> Customer (on CustomerId)
- Customer -> Employee (on SupportRepId = EmployeeId)
- InvoiceLine -> Track (on TrackId)
- Track -> Album (on AlbumId)
- Album -> Artist (on ArtistId)
- Track -> Genre (on GenreId)
- Track -> MediaType (on MediaTypeId)

The resulting table should contain 2240 rows (one per invoice line item).

After creating and populating the table, save the database file (Ctrl+S or File > Save) to persist changes.
